A2A Interop Lab

This org is one node in a cross-platform agent-to-agent interoperability lab. Salesforce Agentforce agents here exchange work with Claude, OpenAI, Google ADK (Vertex AI), Microsoft Foundry, and AWS Strands — the same scenario run over REST, MCP, and the A2A protocol, with every wire payload recorded.

What in this org supports the lab


Agentforce Agents. Platform-native service agents — one twin paired to each external platform — delegate out to remote agents through an Apex invocable and the GA Agent API, and answer inbound A2A / MCP calls through the lab's shims. Every delegation is stamped with a guard rider and recorded.


Zero-Copy observability → Tableau Next. The lab’s agent-execution traces live in an Aurora PostgreSQL store in AWS. Data 360 federates them into this org by Zero Copy — the rows are read live from Aurora, nothing is copied into Salesforce — and a Tableau Next dashboard reads that federated data. Open the A2A Lab Traffic tab to view it.
